RISK DESCRIPTION:
The risk that we do not have
sufficient financial resources to
meet our obligations when they
fall due, or can only meet these
obligations at a high financial
cost.
RISK MANAGEMENT AND MITIGATION:
The Company runs liquidity stress tests and
scenario analyses regularly to ensure that robust
and optimal funding and use plans exist for best,
plausible, and worst-case liquidity situations.
Maintaining of an optimal balance of liquid
assets through investment in fixed income
securities with a good credit rating.

RISK DESCRIPTION:
This is the risk that guarantees
that we have issued to the
benefit of some of our investee
companies will be called up.
RISK MANAGEMENT AND MITIGATION:
Effecient portfolio oversight to ensure the
investee companies remain on course to deliver
their strategies and retain the required liquidity to
meet their obligations.

RISK DESCRIPTION:
This is the risk that our
business may be adversely
affected by:
• New laws/regulations
affecting our core
business.
• Ongoing litigation against
us, our subsidiaries, or
associates.
RISK MANAGEMENT AND MITIGATION:
Compliance checks for all entities are conducted
quarterly.
There is proactive engagement with regulators
on any changes in the business.
